notes: The only official schedule read is Colmobil's Hebrew i20 manual (edition 11.2018, Kappa engines, mapped to MY2018-2021). The MY2016 IL i20 1.4 with 1396 cc is most likely the Gamma G4FA engine, so that manual's figures (e.g. spark plugs 160,000 km, coolant first 200,000 km/120 months) may not transfer; applicability is recorded as stated. No official MY2014-2017 (Gamma) schedule was found: the EU English manual defers to a service booklet that is not public, and ManualsLib/manuals.plus were blocked. IL interval evidence splits between 15,000 km/12 months (manual 2018+, auto-abc 2014-2018, Walla gen1) and 'first at 15,000 then every 20,000 km' (garage page + gen1 forum threads that cite the importer's 2009 manual). Hebrew quotes from the manual are transcriptions of table rows (Hebrew columns read from rendered pages and PyMuPDF text); the km/months header for every table is 'מספר חודשים או מרחק נסיעה, המוקדם מבין שניהם'. Fuel additive: add every 15,000 km or 12 months (IL manual p.6-12), not a listed task code. Tyres inspected every 15,000 km/12 months; no tyre-rotation interval found.
